{"reason": "Failure rows show v1 arbitrates on low-confidence events: 6/8 examples have confidence 0.44-0.67 (only 0.83/0.91 remain). Adding a high-confidence? conjunct removes those false arbitrations, cutting the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate, while the strong pct/exposure/unfrozen gate preserves recall above the 0.8 business floor.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
